validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="a">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="count" expr="0"/>
    <data id="done" expr="false()"/>
    <data id="user"><name xmlns="">bob</name></data>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" cond="$cuont > 3" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `$cuont` is not a declared XPath variable
notes: an XPath variable exists only for a declared `<data id>` (and `<foreach item/index>` or `idlocation` names once they run) or a system variable; evaluating an undeclared one raises `error.execution`
